title: Hooded Deity Over Chaos
description: A black and white line drawing of a multi-armed hooded figure with a halo stands atop a dark textured mound. The figure has multiple outstretched hands and emits swirling smoke and small dark symbols, while the lower half of the image is covered in a dense cluster of colorful overlapping circles and rings in many hues.
prompt: A surreal black and white ink drawing of a tall multi-armed hooded skeletal figure with a glowing golden halo, standing atop a dark mound and releasing swirling smoke and floating symbols from its many hands, the bottom third of the composition completely filled with a dense overlapping field of vibrant multicolored circles and rings in green, purple, blue, red and yellow, mystical and chaotic atmosphere, high contrast, detailed linework
